image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated on a wooden balcony within a church or concert hall. The organ features a Gothic-revival style wooden case with three main towers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, topped with decorative spires. A crystal chandelier hangs in the foreground to the right, partially obscuring the view. The background shows white arched walls and ceiling.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The central tower contains tall pipes, while side sections have shorter pipes, fulfilling the 'dramatic stepped silhouette' requirement.
